landmarks.source: Origin = clock tower centre; footprint and heading from DataSF building footprints (ynuv-fyni) sf16_bldgid 201006.0000058. Clock nodes clock_*_N/E/S/W name MODEL-frame dials (N = front, -Z), not compass points; placed here they face N 233.8 (SW), E 323.8 (NW), S 53.8 (NE), W 143.8 (SE). See assets/blender/README.md.
Embarcadero Plaza on the Market St axis, facing up Market (Wikipedia coordinate cross-checked against DataSF street centrelines). See assets/blender/README.md.

Interim proxy: three-legged lattice, published dimensions (297.8 m). Centre and leg bearings from the LiDAR crossarm footprints; replaces the probe's six records and draws each where the sim has it. Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.

Interim far-visible silhouette: towers, deck, main cables. Axis from the Hwy 101 road end through the published centre; origin = south tower at sea level. Pre-release legal checklist (design.md). Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.

Interim far-visible silhouette of the west span: four towers, centre anchorage, double deck, cables. Axis = I-80 edge c14248000; piers where the DEM marks them; origin = mid eastern main span at sea level. Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.

Interim shape: tapered four-sided tower with wings and spire (260 m), no window grid. Pre-release legal checklist (design.md). Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.
Interim shape: 64 m fluted column with its arcade and crown on the base building record. Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.
Interim shape: the block (record footprint) with pilasters, colonnaded drum, dome and lantern (93 m). Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.
Interim shape: the rotunda's eight piers, arches (closed by shadow: the record is solid in the sim), drum and dome (49 m). Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.
Interim shape: nave and transept roofs on the record footprint, twin towers, rose window, fleche over the crossing (70 m). Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.

Prop: the gate across Grant Ave just north of Bush St, portals facing south, spanning the building faces. Blank plaque, no characters. Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.
Interim shape: the ruined pool walls and standing water on the DEM's basin shelf at Lands End. Site: assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/blender/README.md.
